description: Caddy with custom Go handler modules compiled in via xcaddy: httparena for /baseline11 and /baseline2, httparena_json for /json/{count}, serializing the JSON body per request from the dataset read at provision time. Native file_server for /static. HTTP/1.1 on :8080, h1 over TLS on :8081, h2 and h3 on :8443.
